title: Log out from the menu

story.iWant: to log out from the menu
story.soThat: nobody else can use my session

criteria.when: they choose Logout in the menu

criteria.then: the login page is shown with an error

criteria.given: a shopper with items in the cart
criteria.when: they log out and sign in again
criteria.then: the cart still holds the items

criteria.when: they press the browser's back button
criteria.then: the product list is not shown

assumptions: Added AC-4 for the back button, which the ticket did not cover. AC-1 to AC-3 are kept as written.
